[Skip to main content](https://parks.novascotia.ca/park/blomidon#main-content) # Blomidon ![Blomidon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/styles/park_teaser/public/Blomidon-Park-2_2.JPG?itok=l3lKpQPw) - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon ![Tent Icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/styles/icon/public/icons/tent__icon.png?itok=iogimGLD) - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon - Icon #### 2026 Operating Season **May 15 to October 12, 2026** ##### **3138 Pereau Road, Blomidon, NS B0P 1H0** ##### **Telephone:**(902) 582-7319 [Reserve Online](https://novascotia.goingtocamp.com/) [Download Park Map](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/Blomidon%20ParkTrail%20Map%202026.pdf) ##### Facilities and Services: | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | ![accessible icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Accessible-Facilities_1.png) | **Accessible Features** | Park office
Restrooms with showers
Look-off | | ![camping icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Camping.png) | **95 Unserviced Campsites** | A mixture of open, partially wooded and wooded campsites. 
Parking, picnic table and campfire ring/grill. | | ![Group Campsite Icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Group%20Camping_0.png) | **Group Campsite** | To book group camping, please contact the Natural Resources Office in [Kentville](https://www.novascotia.ca/natr/staffdir/offices.asp). | | ![shower icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Restrooms-Showers.png) | **Restroom with Shower** | Washroom facility with mens and womens washrooms with toilets and showers.
Parking area 30m from building with a gravel/grass path to entrance.  
Level, concrete landing leads to doorway  with 33" clear width and level thresholds.  
Accessible toilet stall with grab bars.  
Roll-in shower with mounted seat, grab bar, and a fixed showerhead. | | ![vault toilet icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Valut%20Toilet_2.png) | **Vault Toilet (Outhouse)** | Vault toilets (outhouses) are available throughout the park | | ![Drinking Water Icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Drinking-Water.png) | **Drinking Water** | Water taps are available throughout the campground | | ![Trailer Dump icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Trailer-Dumping_0.png) | **Trailer Dump** | Dump station available | | ![park office icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/Park%20Office.png) | **Park Office** | New park office opening 2021. | | ![Registration Kiosk icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/Registration%20Kiosk.png) | **Registration Kiosk** | Self registration from Sept 5th to October 12th | | ![Firewood icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/Firewood.png) | **Firewood/Ice** | Firewood and ice can be purchased at the Park Office
Times posted at the park | | ![Cooking Shelter Icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/Cooking%20Shelter.png) | **Cooking Shelter** | | | ![Program Area Icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/Program%20Area.png) | **Program Area** | Centrally located near the Emma Tichenor Campers' Centre, an outdoor space for 
public events and programs. | | ![Group Use Shelter Icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/Group%20Use%20Shelter.png) | **Group Use Shelter** | Emma Tichenor Campers' Centre | | ![waste recycling icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/Garbage-Recycling.png) | **Waste/Recycling** | Waste sorting and recycling containers located throughout the park.
Please do not dispose of propane cylinders or coals in the garbage containers. | | ![Picnic table icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Picnic_0.png) | **Day Use/Picnic Area** | Picnic tables, picnic shelters, water taps, vault toilets next to the Jodrey Trail.
Available for non-campers use. | | ![Beach Access Icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Beach_0.png) | **Beach Access** | Saltwater on the Minas Basin. Tidal mud flats with sandstone and mudstone.
Parking, picnic tables, change house and trail access. | | ![Change house icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Change-Room_1.png) | **Change House** | Located near the beach | | ![trail icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Hiking.png) | **Hiking Trail** | A 13.5 km system of interconnected trails provides access to a variety of habitats and 
numerous scenic look-offs within the park. 
[Hiking at Blomidon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/blomidon-hiking-trails)
[Trail Map](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/Blomidon%20Trail%20Map%202026.pdf) | | ![Playground icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Playground.png) | **Playground** | Centrally located near the Emma Tichenor Campers' Centre | | ![Lookout icon](https://parks.novascotia.ca/sites/default/files/inline-images/ParksNS_Lookout_0.png) | **Look Off** | Numerous look-offs on the trails.
